channel.title: Comments on: My favorite ‘Mixing Pods’ Commercial
channel.description: Insights from work, home, and fatherhood and how they all mix together

item.title: By: Derrick
item.dc:creator: Derrick
item.description:
Did you really just compare yourself to Mel Gibson? Brave Heart will never be the same for me again!
I love a good commercial and am excited for them today!!!
